description: a giant pangolin as big as a bear standing upright on its two hind legs, its whole body covered in big overlapping olive-brown scales like a pine cone or armour, a small pointed head with a long snout and small eyes, both front legs raised high with huge curved claws ready to slash, a long thick scaly tail curving behind it, one wide chunky shape filling the whole picture, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the animal alone, no branch, no ground, no background, the whole animal inside the picture, the whole tail too
